title: Trouvez un RDV pour une coiffure à domicile près de chez vous - RDV360

facts.fact: The page states that the home hairdresser service is generally available until 19h, and it can be extended past 19h depending on urgency.
facts.quote: Ce service est généralement disponible jusqu’à 19h. Toutefois, en fonction de votre urgence, il est possible de vous entendre avec votre coiffeur

facts.fact: The page gives an indicative price of 10 to 15 euros for a haircut (coupe) at home.
The page gives an indicative price of 16 to 20 euros for a hair coloring (coloration) at home.
The page gives an indicative price of 90 to 120 euros for a bridal hairstyle (coiffure de mariée) at home.
The page gives an indicative price of 15 to 19 euros for a blow-dry (brushing) at home.
The page gives an indicative price of 25 to 29 euros for a cut and blow-dry (coupe brushing) at home.
The page gives an indicative price of 41 to 51 euros for a palette highlights (mèche à palette) at home.
The page gives an indicative price of 51 to 61 euros for palette highlights combined with a cut (mèche à palette + coupe) at home.
The page gives an indicative price of 80 to 150 euros for a balayage at home.
The page states that home hairdressing prices in the provinces are generally lower by 10 to 20 euros than in cities.
facts.quote: En province par exemple, ils sont généralement minorés de 10 à 20€.

facts.fact: The page says a booking request left by message is typically followed by a call back within a few hours to set an appointment.
facts.quote: Vous y laissez votre message et quelques heures plus tard, vous êtes contacté pour fixer un rendez-vous
